skill.name: pptx
skill.description: Create, edit, analyze, validate, and visually review PowerPoint presentations using HTML, OOXML, templates, and local conversion tools.
skill.summary: Build and edit PPTX presentations with structured creation, template, OOXML, and validation workflows.
skill.author: 92Bilal26

security_audit.summary: AI review confirmed real risks from unbounded Office archive extraction, subprocess-based document conversion, and privileged dependency installation guidance. Most URL, traversal, obfuscation, environment, and backtick findings are false positives from OOXML schema metadata, Markdown code spans, and JavaScript template literals. The skill should be treated as high risk unless archive handling and external command execution are sandboxed. Static review was capped at 400/506 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 106 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Office archives are extracted with extractall without explicit member validation.
remediation.suggestion: Validate each ZIP member path, reject absolute or parent-relative names, and enforce size and file count limits before extraction.

remediation.issue: Document conversion invokes local binaries on user-provided presentation files.
remediation.suggestion: Run LibreOffice, Poppler, and related converters in a sandbox with time, memory, filesystem, and network limits.

remediation.issue: Dependency instructions include sudo and global package installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Move installation steps outside the skill workflow, require explicit user confirmation, and prefer isolated virtual environments.

remediation.issue: Generated outputs can write to user-specified paths.
remediation.suggestion: Constrain output paths to the workspace, warn before overwriting files, and create backups for modified presentations.

content.value_statement: PowerPoint work often needs precise layout control and file-level validation. This skill provides structured workflows for creating, editing, and reviewing PPTX files.
actual_capabilities: Creates new PPTX decks from HTML slide layouts using PptxGenJS guidance.
Edits existing presentations through unpacked Office Open XML files.
Rearranges template slides by index to build a new deck structure.
Extracts and replaces presentation text while preserving formatting metadata.
Generates thumbnail grids for visual review and layout validation.
Validates OOXML structure before repacking modified presentations.
limitations: Requires local Python, Node, LibreOffice, and Poppler tools for several workflows.
Works best when source decks are valid PPTX files without encryption.
Complex animations and advanced PowerPoint effects may need manual review.
Template workflows require careful slide index and placeholder validation.

use_cases.title: Create a Client Presentation
use_cases.description: Build a polished slide deck from an outline, then validate layout with thumbnails.

use_cases.title: Adapt a Branded Template
use_cases.description: Select template slides, duplicate them, and replace placeholder text while preserving design rules.

use_cases.title: Inspect and Repair PPTX Content
use_cases.description: Unpack a presentation, review OOXML files, edit slide content, and validate before repacking.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 6-slide PowerPoint deck about our quarterly results. Use a clean business style and include speaker notes.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Presentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this PPTX file. Summarize the slide structure, main messages, design issues, and any content gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Template Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this template to create a sales presentation. Keep the brand style and choose layouts that match the content.

prompt_templates.title: Edit OOXML Precisely
prompt_templates.prompt: Update slide 4 in this PPTX by editing the OOXML. Validate the package and confirm the file opens correctly.

output_examples.input: A product launch outline with seven sections and brand colors.
output_examples.output: A finished PowerPoint deck with title, agenda, product story, market data, roadmap, pricing, and closing slides.

output_examples.input: A branded template deck and a new webinar outline.
output_examples.output: A new deck that reuses selected template layouts, replaces placeholder text, and keeps visual consistency.

output_examples.input: An existing PPTX with layout problems after text changes.
output_examples.output: A corrected deck plus thumbnail review notes describing fixed overflow, spacing, and contrast issues.

best_practices: Create thumbnails after each major deck change and inspect them before final delivery.
Keep a backup of the original PPTX before unpacking or editing OOXML files.
Use template inventories to verify slide indices and placeholder counts before replacing content.
anti_patterns: Do not edit XML without validating the package before repacking.
Do not force content into a template layout with too many placeholders.
Do not rely only on extracted text when visual layout matters.

faq.question: Can this skill create a PPTX from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides HTML slide creation and conversion into PowerPoint through PptxGenJS.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing PowerPoint file?
faq.answer: Yes. It can unpack PPTX files, edit OOXML content, validate files, and repack the presentation.

faq.question: Does it support branded templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It can analyze a template, select slide layouts, rearrange slides, and replace text.

faq.question: What tools are required?
faq.answer: Some workflows need Python packages, Node packages, LibreOffice, Poppler, and Playwright.

faq.question: Can it check visual quality?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate thumbnail grids so users can inspect layout, overflow, and contrast.

faq.question: Is it safe to run on untrusted PPTX files?
faq.answer: Use caution. The workflows unpack archives and run document converters, so sandboxing is recommended.
